questions.1_child_datasets_available: speechocean762 (SLR101, CC BY 4.0, 250 spk/5000 utt, 122 children), SIAK (172 spk/16308 utt, rating-only), Zenodo 200495 (11 children, test-only)
questions.2_phoneme_labels: speechocean762: per-phone human accuracy 0/1/2 + canonical ARPAbet. SIAK/Zenodo: none
questions.3_language_accent: so762 non-native English (Mandarin L1); SIAK Finnish/UK/other; LWE target = Vietnamese-L1 children (no matching corpus)
questions.5_speaker_counts: so762 child train 58 / child test 64 (disjoint); SIAK 172; Zenodo 11
questions.6_target_vocabulary: so762 read sentences; SIAK 320 single words; LWE numbers/words
questions.7_label_reliability: so762: 5 independent experts, 96.4% of phone judgments are score 2, explicit notation for 1/0/insertion; reliable enough for quality-filtered targets, NOT for phone transcription
questions.8_label_levels: so762 phone+word+sentence; SIAK utterance rating; Zenodo word
questions.9_training_license: so762 CC BY 4.0 allows training and commercial use; SIAK CC-BY-ND allows model building/evaluation per README (legal review open)
questions.10_enough_for_finetune: Enough for SMALL head-only adaptation on frozen encoder (1,160 child utterances / 58 speakers) on CPU; NOT enough for full fine-tuning within local CPU constraints
questions.11_speaker_disjoint_test: yes: so762 official child test (64 spk) + SIAK test (27 spk) + LWE external (never trained)
questions.12_local_runtime: head-only adaptation: model stays XLSR-53 large 1.26 GB; head < 10 MB; CPU inference unchanged (head adds <5 ms/frame batch)

conclusion.reason: no dataset provides human phone TRANSCRIPTIONS of what the child actually said; so762 gives scores on canonical phones, SIAK/Zenodo give none
conclusion.plan: freeze encoder (facebook/wav2vec2-xlsr-53-espeak-cv-ft); train a small Conv1d CTC head on so762 TRAIN children; canonical targets; per-utterance weight = mean human phone score/2; mask utterances with mean < 0.5; evaluate speaker-disjoint on so762 test children + SIAK test speakers + LWE external (test only)
stop_conditions: if B1 does not improve down-stream human-anchored metrics under FRR-first, report falsified and recommend dataset acquisition
